literal: And manly effort, and abundant wisdom, called of these two, by the unceasing action, will rise the family.
translation: A family will rise and prosper through the unceasing practice of two qualities: manly effort and mature wisdom.
modern: முயற்சியும் நிறைந்த அறிவும் ஆகிய இவ்விரண்டின் இடைவிடாத செயல்பாட்டினால் ஒருவனுடைய குடி உயர்வடையும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the two essential pillars required to elevate one's family or lineage (குடி). These are active, manly effort (ஆள்வினை) and mature, deep wisdom (ஆன்ற அறிவு). The poet emphasizes that merely possessing these qualities is not enough; they must be put into continuous, unceasing action (நீள்வினை). It is through this sustained application of effort and wisdom that a family's status and honor will grow and rise (நீளும்).
